exposure: Type of HDP (chronic hypertension, gestational hypertension, pre-eclampsia, eclampsia)
cohort: 451 women admitted with HDPs to Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital in Ghana
finding: Women with pre-eclampsia/eclampsia were at higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including caesarean section and preterm delivery, compared to those with chronic/gestational hypertension.
mod_finding: Women with pre-eclampsia/eclampsia had a higher risk of caesarean section compared to women with chronic/gestational hypertension.
